newsitem.title: USA: New Mexico debt reform measure passes - TV report.
newsitem.headline: New Mexico debt reform measure passes - TV report.

text.p: A debt reform initiative on the ballot in New Mexico appeared to pass on Tuesday, according to a local television report.
Station KRQE, Channel 13 in Albuquerque, reported that Amendment Two appeared to narrowly pass.
The television station said Amendment Two garnered 53 percent support with 97 percent of precincts reporting.
Amendment Two would provide a limited exception to the constitutional requirement that voters in a school district must approve the creation of any general obligation debt of the district.

Local television stations said Amendment Seven was too close to call. The amendment would authorize counties to borrow money to acquire real estate for open space and open-space related uses and to purchase capital equipment for road and bridge construction and repair.
